"import cadquery as cq

# Sketch plane: local (u, v) maps to global (x, y, z) = (0, u, v)
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Local sketch coordinates (mm) defining the open orthogonal chain
pts = [
    (6, 3),      # start of segment 1
    (6, 25),     # end 1 / start 2
    (-13, 25),   # end 2 / start 3
    (-13, 41),   # end 3 / start 4
    (28, 41),    # end 4 / start 5
    (28, 53),    # end of segment 5
]

# Convert to world coordinates exactly (no grid snapping)
world = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for (u, v) in pts]

# Build exactly 5 line edges; consecutive edges share coincident endpoints
edges = [cq.Edge.makeLine(world[i], world[i + 1]) for i in range(len(world) - 1)]
assert len(edges) == 5

# Sanity check: all vertices lie on the YZ plane (global x = 0)
for e in edges:
    for v in e.Vertices():
        assert abs(v.X) < 1e-9, "vertex off YZ plane"

# Export the open chain as a compound of 5 edges
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
